title: Synthesis of Multi-walled Carbon Nanotubes Modified with Silver Nanoparticles and Evaluation of Their Antibacterial Activities and Cytotoxic Properties
protocol: Measure 30 - 50 mg of MWCNT into a 50-mL vial.
Slowly add 8 mL of H2SO4:HNO3 solution (90% initial concentration, 3:1 vol/vol) using a pipette with 1 mL tips.
Allow the exothermic reaction to complete for 30 min.
Sonicate the solution at 60 - 80 °C and 160 W for 1 h until MWCNT settles at the bottom of the vial.
Transfer the solution to a centrifuge tube.
With a micropipette, add 30 mL of distilled water dropwise to the MWCNT-COOH solution.
Centrifuge the MWCNT-COOH solution at 12,000 x g and room temperature for 15 min.
Remove the supernatant with a pipette and 1 mL pipette tip.
Add 5 mL of ethanol with a pipette and 1 mL pipette tip.
Rinse the walls of the vial with additional pipetted ethanol.
Centrifuge the solution at 12,000 x g and room temperature for 15 min.
Determine pH of supernatant with pH paper.
Repeat washing and centrifuging until the supernatant pH is neutral.
Remove all supernatant.
Add 1 mL of distilled water to precipitate and disperse MWCNT-COOH evenly in solution.
Freeze-dry solution at -60°C under vacuum until dry.
Place 10 mg of MWCNT-COOH in a 50-mL conical tube.
Dilute with 30 mL of distilled water.
Sonicate solution at 60°C and 160 W for 1 h.
Place 6 mL of 0.1 N AgNO3 in a 50-mL conical tube.
Dilute with 18 mL of distilled water.
Sonicate solution at 60°C and 160 W for 1 h.
Add the AgNO3 solution dropwise to the MWCNTs solution while sonicating at 60°C and 160 W.
Continue sonicating for 1 h after adding the AgNO3.
Centrifuge the solution at 12,000 x g and room temperature for 15 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Repeat washing and centrifuging two additional times.
Add 1 mL of distilled water to the Ag-MWCNTs mixture.
Disperse the precipitate evenly in the solution.
Add 5 mL of ethanol to the solution.
Allow the reaction to proceed at room temperature for 1 h.
Centrifuge the solution at 12,000 x g and room temperature for 15 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Determine pH of supernatant with pH paper.
Repeat washing and centrifuging until supernatant pH is neutral.
Add 1 mL of distilled water to Ag-MWCNTs.
Disperse evenly in solution.
Freeze-dry the solution at -70°C under vacuum for 24 h.
Mix 18.12 g of R2A agar with 1 L of distilled water in a flask.
Sterilize the mixture in an autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min.
Allow gel to cool at room temperature.
Place 10 mL of gel in Petri dishes prior to hardening to prepare the solid medium.
Place 100 μL of bacteria on the solid medium.
Spread the bacteria on the solid medium using a spreader.
Incubate the dishes at 30 °C for 48 h.
Mix 3.12 g of R2A broth with 1 L of distilled water in a flask.
Sterilize the mixture in an autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min.
Transfer the grown colonies to a liquid medium using a loop and needle.
Incubate in an incubator at 180 rpm and 30 °C.
Record the OD value by UV spectrophotometry at 600 nm on an hourly basis.
Mix 3.12 g of R2A broth and 8 g of agar with 1 L of distilled water.
Sterilize the mixture in an autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min.
Place 10 mL of this gel on the bottom agar.
Load 50 μL of Ag-MWCNTs solution on sterile paper disc with a micropipette.
Dry and sterilize Ag-MWCNTs sample in a vacuum chamber under UV light for 30 min.
Place Ag-MWCNTs sample on agar.
Incubate the agar plate at 30 °C for 48 h.
Measure zone of inhibition.
Inoculate 100 μL of bacteria into 3 mL of fresh liquid medium using a pipette and 100-µL micro pipette tip.
Prepare five 50 µL samples of the control solution in 15-mL conical tubes.
Add methanol to the first tube.
Add 1000 µg/mL MWCNT-COOH to the second tube.
Add 50 µg/mL Ag-MWCNTs to the third tube.
Add 40 µg/mL Ag-MWMWCNTs to the fourth tube.
Add 30 µg/mL Ag-MWCNTs to the fifth tube.
Incubate at 180 rpm and 30 °C until the control is maximally active as determined by UV spectrophotometry.
Measure the OD value of each sample.
Calculate the MIC concentration.
Spread the cultured bacteria on a solid medium with a spreader.
Count bacterial colonies and measure CFU values to determine antibacterial activity.
Remove culture cells from incubator.
Suction the medium and wash three times with a dropwise wash of 5 mL of PBS.
Add 1 mL of trypsin-EDTA in PBS to the washed cell.
Suction after 1 min.
Tap the plate to remove stuck cells.
Add 5 mL of DMEM to the samples and remove cells.
Centrifuge samples at 200 x g for 3 min, removing supernatant after centrifugation.
Add 1 mL of DPBS to the samples and mix thoroughly.
Count cells in 10 µL of the solution using an automated cell-counting machine.
Place 1 × 10^5 AML12 cells per well in a six-well plate with DMEM containing 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% sterile antibiotic.
Incubate the plate for 8 - 12 h at 37 °C in a 5% CO2/95% air environment.
Suction the supernatant from wells using an aspirator.
Add each sample (control, NMS-DMSO, and Ag-MWCNT) to 1 mL of DMEM.
Incubate samples at 37 °C in a 5% CO2/95% air environment for 8 h.
Remove supernatant after incubation.
Wash samples with 5 mL of PBS.
Add 1 mL of live/dead kit dropwise to the cells.
Incubate the cells at room temperature for 30 - 45 min or at 37 °C for 10 min.
Measure fluorescence using standard fluorescence microscopy at 100X or 300X magnification.
Prepare samples according to steps 5.1 through 5.6.2 above.
Remove supernatant from the wells.
Wash plate with 1 mL of 1x DPBS and decant excess liquid.
Add 1 mL of trypsin to the plate and incubate for 3 min to detach cells.
Use cell culture medium to wash plate, collecting detached cells.
Place collected cells in a 15-mL tube.
Centrifuge tube at 200 x g and 4 °C for 3 min.
Discard supernatant.
Add 1 mL of fresh medium to cell pellet.
Re-disperse the cells.
Mix 10 µL of trypan blue with 10 µL of dispersed cells.
Count the cells using an automated cell-counting machine.
